title: Helsinki Grotesk Pro / Character Set
slide_intent: Check character coverage before committing a message to a typeface so names, numbers and language-specific marks can be represented.
strategic_value: A broad glyph inventory can support consistent Helsinki communications across languages and data.
demonstration: Two dense columns group Latin and Cyrillic letters, figures, punctuation, mathematical signs, arrows, fractions, accents and alternates.
practical_value: Check a required character against the supplied inventory rather than assuming every script is supported.

content_islands.name: Core characters
content_islands.spec: Left groups show alphabets, figures, punctuation and symbols with small labels.

content_islands.name: Extended characters
content_islands.spec: Right groups show accents, accented letters, inferiors and stylistic variants.
